currentRCA.problem: Drum Chiller bearing is damaged causing jamming  (37.7 hrs)

fields.label: Why 1
fields.value: Drum Roller Bearing Jammed

fields.label: Why 2
fields.value: It was jammed as bearing was found dry

fields.label: Why 3
fields.value: This is the oil type bearing and no oil lubrication was performed.

fields.label: Why 4
fields.value: As its roller seals are leaked so gravity oil pipe was bent due to which oil was not circulating and lubricating the bearing

fields.label: Why 5
fields.value: Seals was not replaced timely as all lead through seals and bearing to be changed after every 2 years

fields.label: Corrective Action
fields.value: Its seal (local) and bearing was replaced, but after two days its seal got leaked again as local seals can’t work here.

fields.label: Preventive Action
fields.value: A complete lead-through set, including seals and bearings, is being arranged as an emergency stock so that all roller seals and bearings can be replaced together. This removes the worn and leaking components on every roller at once and eliminates the risk of repeat dry-running and jamming. Afterwards TBM will be followed.

fields.label: Why 1
fields.value: Vacuum is taking time to get stable

fields.label: Why 2
fields.value: Air is entering the chamber and vacuum lines through several leak points, so the vacuum drops or drifts.

fields.label: Why 3
fields.value: Seals, O-rings, bellows and joints have worn, hardened or been damaged.

fields.label: Why 4
fields.value: They were not inspected or replaced on a timely basis.Pumping speed is low, so they cannot overcome the leak load or recover the vacuum quickly. Internal wear and clearance loss have reduced pump efficiency

fields.label: Why 5
fields.value: Timely maintenance, including the OEM overhaul with original spare parts, was not carried out. They have run beyond their service and overhaul interval.Timely maintenance, including the OEM overhaul with original spare parts, was not carried out

fields.label: Corrective Action
fields.value: Complete leak test was done and found multiple leakages from chamber seal, its roller seal are also damaged. All seals and o-ring have been replaced by locally arranged parts for time being

fields.label: Preventive Action
fields.value: A major overhauling of machine will be going to happen in 2nd quarter of 2027 in which all pumps will be overhauled which need to be followed after every 4 years intervals and their all rollers lead through will be changed by OEM through their original parts, which need to be ensure to replace timely after every 2 years.

currentRCA.problem: Water leakages from oven flapper (48.22 hrs)

fields.label: Why 1
fields.value: Water leakage was observed from multiple points of oven, flapper, shield shutter and spacer.

fields.label: Why 2
fields.value: The circulating water is attacking the metal. Out-of-spec pH, hardness, chlorides, conductivity or dissolved oxygen cause corrosion and scale.

fields.label: Why 3
fields.value: The water supply or treatment is not controlled to the required quality, so untreated or poorly treated water is entering the oven circuit.

fields.label: Why 4
fields.value: There is no routine testing against the specification, and no treatment dosing, filtration, softening or blowdown to keep the circuit within limits.

fields.label: Why 5
fields.value: Each repair fixed only the leaking spot (patching, welding, replacing a fitting). The cause, the water quality, was never corrected, so new leaks keep appearing in other weakened areas.

fields.label: Corrective Action
fields.value: Repair the current leak points, where metal is badly thinned or pitted.

fields.label: Preventive Action
fields.value: To eliminate this issue completely need to replace all old, damaged and corroded parts. Need to drain water and flush the system. Proper water analysis and monitoring fortnightly to be ensured after parts replacement. Nalco will monitor onwards from now.
